claim_en: IRREVOCABLY. The perpetuity word glossed identically by Sifra and Onkelos; the strangers clause.
THE DOMAIN. Land, houses, the Hebrew slave; not slaves, documents, movables.
THE SALE GATE. Only the impoverished sell, never all; the nearest redeems first; gifts included.
FOUR CONSTRAINTS. Own means; not far-for-near, bad-for-good, borrowed, or by halves.
THE RECKONING. Counterpart by favorable price; the lesser figure whether improved or fallen.
THE INVERSION. The redeemer by the owner's order; the sanctuary's four constraints inverted; the Jubilee at its start, the seventh at its end.
THE ROSTER. Walled since Joshua, a gazetteer as input; at once; the year from the first sale.
THE FULL YEAR. 365 or twelve months; the house-scope and wall disputes; Hillel's repair of the hiding exploit; the sanctuary has no generations.
THE VILLAGE. Two courtyards of two; the field's Jubilee and deduction with the house's at-once.
THE LEVITES. Perpetual redemption against the floor, the year-limit, and the forfeit.
LEVITE FROM LEVITE. The disqualified sons out; sale not consecration; the heir cases.
ZONING. Three bands fixed for the Levites; one-way upward for Israel; the treasurer's sale barred.
THE FALLING LOAD. Support before the fall, again and again; your life first.
INTEREST. Two terms by two worked cases; guarantor allowed; the one flask; the Exodus condition.
THE LAND CLAUSE. Dwelling as acceptance of kingship.
